academic_research_inversion.title: A Perfectly Truthful Calibration Measure
academic_research_inversion.key_findings: Argues sampled calibration measures can incentivize predictors to appear calibrated; proposes averaged two-bin calibration error (ATB). Directly relevant to probability truthfulness, not sports rank inversion.

academic_research_inversion.title: Mitigating Bias in Calibration Error Estimation
academic_research_inversion.key_findings: Equal-mass bins have lower bias than equal-width bins; recommends debiased estimator and ECE_sweep. No rank-inversion finding stated.

academic_research_inversion.title: Evaluating model calibration in classification
academic_research_inversion.key_findings: Develops a probability-grounded calibration framework and multidimensional reliability diagrams; no rank-inversion result stated.
